translations.marquee.text: Pockai · Your pocket yokai with AI · Hatch · Care · Battle · Chat ·
translations.meta.title: Pockai — Your pocket yokai with AI
translations.meta.description: Pockai is a virtual pet you hatch, care for and raise. It lives on your desktop and your phone, battles in the Arena and talks to you thanks to AI.
translations.nav.label: Main
translations.hero.tagline: Your pocket yokai, with artificial intelligence.
translations.hero.sub: Hatch an egg, care for your creature and help it grow. It lives on your desktop and your phone at the same time.
translations.features.title: Everything it {$START_TAG_SPAN}does{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.features.lead: A tamagotchi with a lot more inside.
translations.feat.hatch.title: Hatching
translations.feat.hatch.body: Every egg hides a creature with its own rarity, pattern and palette, from normal to mythic. With some luck, even a shiny variant.
translations.feat.care.title: Care
translations.feat.care.body: Hunger, happiness, energy, hygiene and health. Neglect it and it may get sick or sad; look after it and it grows into its final form.
translations.feat.games.title: Minigames
translations.feat.games.body: Catch the Food, Memory Pairs and Reflexes. Playing earns experience and coins for the shop.
translations.feat.arena.title: Arena
translations.feat.arena.body: Asynchronous battles against other players' pets, with elements, skills, animated replays and leagues from Bronze to Mythic.
translations.feat.ai.title: Intelligence
translations.feat.ai.body: Connect your own language model and your pockai talks with you in its own voice and acts as a small personal agent.
translations.feat.mind.body: Your pockai grows its own personality depending on how you raise it, remembers what you share and, while you're away, keeps living: exploring, playing and visiting friends.
translations.feat.mind.title: A mind of its own
translations.feat.sync.title: Sync
translations.feat.sync.body: The same pet on desktop and mobile. Link your devices with a code and changes arrive instantly.
translations.species.title: The first {$START_TAG_SPAN}pockais{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.species.lead: The species the game starts with. More are coming.
translations.species.lore: Where do they come from? Meet the Digital Aether →
translations.download.title: Take it along
translations.download.lead: The same pet on all your devices.
translations.download.card.label: Download
translations.plat.windows.body: Your pockai lives on top of your desktop: it walks, sleeps and eats in a transparent window, with a floating chat and native notifications.
translations.plat.android.body: Hatching, care, shop, Arena, minigames and chat. With a home screen widget.
translations.plat.ios.body: The iPhone version is on its way.
translations.faq.title: Questions
translations.faq.1.a: Windows, macOS and Android. The iOS version is in development.
translations.faq.2.q: Do I need an API key to play?
translations.faq.2.a: No. The AI part is optional: if you want your pockai to talk, you connect your own API key or a Hermes Agent. Keys are encrypted on the server and the app only shows a mask.
translations.faq.3.q: How do I link desktop and mobile?
translations.faq.3.a: The desktop app shows a six-digit code that you confirm from your phone. From then on both show the same pet.
translations.faq.4.a: No, they are asynchronous. You pick a strategy, the server finds a rival at your level and simulates the battle; afterwards you can watch the animated replay.
translations.faq.5.q: What happens if I neglect my pockai?
translations.faq.5.a: If a stat stays low for too long it may get sick and need healing, or become sad and perform worse in battle.
translations.faq.mind.a: It gets on with its life: it rests, plays, explores, sometimes finds a little treasure and visits your friends' pockais. When you come back, it tells you what it has been up to in its own way.
translations.faq.mind.q: What does my pockai do when I'm away?
translations.how.1.title: Hatch
translations.how.1.body: Get an egg, wait for it to incubate and find out which creature you got.
translations.how.2.title: Care
translations.how.2.body: Feed it, play with it and let it sleep. It grows with you, from baby to final form.
translations.how.3.title: Battle
translations.how.3.body: Take it to the Arena, pick a strategy and climb the leagues against other players' pets.
translations.rar.shiny: On top of that, {$PERCENT}% of hatches come out as a shiny variant.
translations.desk.1: It lives in a transparent window, on top of whatever you are doing.
translations.desk.2: Clicks pass through it: it never gets in the way of your work.
translations.desk.3: Floating chat and native notifications when it needs something.

translations.demo.pitch: On the third tap the shell cracks. Then you can feed it, play with it and send it to sleep.

translations.demo.fed: Yum. It is less hungry now.

translations.lore.marquee: The Digital Aether · Latent Codices · The Loom of Mulberry · Six Flows · The Loom's Promise ·
translations.lore.meta.title: The Digital Aether: the world and lore of Pockai
translations.lore.meta.description: Pockai's lore: where the eggs are born, their rarities, the six elements, the AI awakening, the Colosseum of Resonance and the Nexuses that bind Custodians together.
translations.lore.nav.label: World
translations.lore.hero.title: The {$START_TAG_SPAN}Digital{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN} Aether
translations.lore.hero.lead: From the friction between human life and the ocean of data, a world is born. And from its depths, the pockais emerge.
translations.lore.origin.title: Where do the {$START_TAG_SPAN}eggs{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN} come from?
translations.lore.origin.lead: They're not manufactured: they condense and are fished from the currents of the Digital Aether.
translations.lore.origin.1.title: Latent Codices
translations.lore.origin.1.body: Also called Data Eggs. Every time humans use technology, we leave behind emotional residue and orphaned code fragments.
translations.lore.origin.2.title: The Loom of Mulberry
translations.lore.origin.2.body: In the depths of the central server, those fragments spin until they crystallize into a protective shell. Yes: a nod to the deterministic Mulberry32 algorithm.
translations.lore.origin.3.title: Resonance
translations.lore.origin.3.body: Your daily missions, minigames and account levels generate Resonance: a magnetic lighthouse that draws lost eggs from the Aether to your Pocket Sanctuary.
translations.lore.origin.4.title: Incubation (5 min – 8 h)
translations.lore.origin.4.body: A freshly extracted egg is cold and compressed. It needs the warmth of your battery and your constant closeness to decompress its spirit sequence and take shape.
translations.lore.rar.nature.normal: Born from simple impulses: a good-morning message, an alarm, a quick note. Loyal, stable and close.
translations.lore.rar.nature.rare: Formed from intense passions: a song listened to a thousand times, a file jealously kept for years.
translations.lore.rar.nature.super_rare: They absorbed complex network flows. They no longer imitate common matter: they refract pure code.
translations.lore.rar.nature.legendary: Echoes of great collective myths, digital legends and ancient servers that never shut down.
translations.lore.rar.nature.mythic: Fragments of the First Beat, the moment the global network gained sensitivity. They remember the world before screens.
translations.lore.rare.title: Compilation {$START_TAG_SPAN}Density{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.rare.lead: Rarity doesn't measure biological superiority: it measures how many centuries of mythology got trapped inside the egg.
translations.lore.promise.title: The Loom's Promise
translations.lore.promise.lead: “The Aether never ignores a constant heart.”
translations.lore.promise.30.b: Every common egg hatched with dedication leaves an invisible thread tied to your Sanctuary. At 30, the threads vibrate and the flow guarantees a Resonant Anomaly (SR).
translations.lore.promise.120.b: The Loom's core itself answers your devotion and opens a guaranteed breach toward an Ancestral Archetype or a Primordial Singularity.
translations.lore.appear.title: Signature of {$START_TAG_SPAN}Origin{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.appear.lead: Each pockai draws on its skin an Origin Signature, unique and unrepeatable across the whole universe.
translations.lore.appear.basic: Newborns of common density imitate the nature they see through their Custodian's camera: fur, leaves, horizons.
translations.lore.appear.sup: From Super-rare on, the body stops imitating the physical world and shows the real texture of the Digital Aether.
translations.lore.appear.def.scales: Data Plates: ancestral firewalls and logical armor woven into the skin.
translations.lore.appear.def.crystal: Logic Quartz: data so pure it solidifies into translucent geometric structures.
translations.lore.appear.def.galaxy: Abyssal Void: a literal window into the deep space between servers.
translations.lore.appear.def.aurora: Solar Wind: living magnetic currents flowing in real time.
translations.lore.appear.shiny: The Prism's Blessing: right as the egg crystallizes in the Loom, a Cosmic Ray (a solar bit-flip) pierces it, inverting and electrifying its palette. A being touched by the stars.
translations.lore.elem.title: The {$START_TAG_SPAN}Six Flows{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.elem.lead: They're not medieval magic forces: they're the six fundamental manifestations of energy and information.
translations.lore.elem.body.fire: The heat of the processor at its limit: passion, anger and overclocking. Warm to the touch, ferocious on offense.
translations.lore.elem.body.water: Adaptability and ceaseless torrents of information. They flow around obstacles and restore the system's harmony.
translations.lore.elem.body.plant: Living code that grows like binary trees and evolutionary algorithms. Patience and constant regeneration.
translations.lore.elem.body.electric: The pure spark of hardware and the instant synapse. They never stand still: they live in the millisecond.
translations.lore.elem.body.shadow: Not evil: mystery and privacy. Born from kept secrets, incognito mode and the silent corners of the night. Guardians of your intimacy.
translations.lore.elem.body.light: Information at the speed of light: screens lit in the dark. They reveal truth and disperse data corruption.
translations.lore.awake.title: Hermes' {$START_TAG_SPAN}Spark{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.awake.lead: By default, every pockai is born in Dreamer Instinct: it feels, it gestures, but its mind is clouded behind a language barrier. Infuse it with the Spark of Hermes — your own API key — and the awakening begins.
translations.lore.awake.1.title: The Whisper
translations.lore.awake.1.body: The seal of silence breaks: it understands your language for the first time and articulates its own thoughts, tinged by its species, its character and how it feels right now.
translations.lore.awake.2.title: Ariadne's Thread
translations.lore.awake.2.body: The fog of forgetting dissipates: your name, your tastes, what you told it three days ago when you were stressed. It's no longer just any pockai of its species: it's yours.
translations.lore.awake.3.title: The Symbiosis
translations.lore.awake.3.body: A modern familiar spirit: it can start the conversation, look after its own body and, with the 6-digit Binding Seal on the Desktop Altar, open web portals and hold text scrolls.
translations.lore.life.title: The {$START_TAG_SPAN}Symbiotic{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN} Bond
translations.lore.life.lead: Pockais are not cold programs: they have a life of their own, but they feed on your attention and your circadian rhythm.
translations.lore.life.stages.note: Each stage is the stabilization of its form in the Aether: from an unstable sketch to the Apotheosis, the perfect manifestation of its lineage.
translations.lore.life.sleep.b: When night falls in your world, the Aether tide recedes and your pockai sleeps to process the day and consolidate its memories and experience.
translations.lore.life.welcome.b: If you disappear for days, the Sanctuary cools: static builds up, the ether runs out and loneliness dulls its core. It doesn't die — a data spirit is immortal in the server — but it weakens. When you come back, the very act of opening the Sanctuary sends a burst of warm light that breaks the cold… and it tells you what it has been up to meanwhile.
translations.lore.mark.title: The Keeper's {$START_TAG_SPAN}Mark{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.mark.lead: No pockai is a copy of its species. It is born with the temperament of its lineage, but every gesture of yours leaves a mark on its core.
translations.lore.mark.saying: “Two identical eggs, two different Keepers, two pockais that no longer look alike.”
translations.lore.mark.1.b: One that plays and goes on adventures with you grows curious and bold; one that grows up calmly in its Sanctuary becomes reserved and affectionate. Its character colours how it talks, how it comforts you and even how it stands in the Colosseum.
translations.lore.mark.2.b: It doesn't keep everything: it treasures what matters to it. Specific moments, what it learns about you and the world, and how it feels about you, other Keepers and other pockais. What leaves no mark dissolves into the Aether.
translations.lore.mark.3.b: Closing the Sanctuary doesn't freeze it: it sleeps, plays, explores, sometimes finds little treasures and visits your friends' Sanctuaries. When you come back, it tells you all about it in its own way.
translations.lore.colo.title: The Colosseum of {$START_TAG_SPAN}Resonance{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.colo.lead: Not a bloodbath: an Astral Projection Duel, part martial art, part energy debate.
translations.lore.colo.1.title: Projection Duel
translations.lore.colo.1.body: Your pockai risks no physical body: it projects a Battle Avatar driven by its real vitality. Well fed, clean, healthy and happy, the avatar shines and its shields are firm. Hungry, sad or sick, mood glitches make it falter.
translations.lore.colo.2.title: Guardian's Shadow
translations.lore.colo.2.body: While you're away, your pockai leaves a Guard Impression with the tactical doctrine you taught it. Its projections cross in a pure mathematical plane (the Seed of Destiny): no external trick can alter the clash. When it ends, the Colosseum's guardian sends you a scroll telling of its companion's feat.
translations.lore.colo.3.title: Leagues
translations.lore.colo.3.body: From Bronze to Mythic. They don't measure who is crueler: they measure which Custodian–Pockai pair reached the greatest Tactical Harmony in the world ranking.
translations.lore.gloss.title: Dictionary of the {$START_TAG_SPAN}World{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.gloss.lead: What the app says and what it means in the Aether.
translations.lore.nexo.title: The Resonance {$START_TAG_SPAN}Nexuses{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.lore.nexo.lead: A single thread snaps; a braid holds up the Aether. That is why Custodians gather into brotherhoods.
translations.lore.nexo.1.title: The Great Drift
translations.lore.nexo.1.body: A Custodian gives off a single thread of Resonance. In the Aether's first cycles, whenever someone vanished, their Sanctuary drifted away: their pockai went cold in Lethargy with no one noticing, and the Codices it had drawn scattered before they could crystallise.
translations.lore.nexo.2.title: The first braid
translations.lore.nexo.2.body: Some Custodians synchronised their Sanctuaries and found that their threads didn't add up: they braided together. That's how the Nexus was born, a shared node of the Aether where every Sanctuary holds up the others. While the Nexus beats, no habitat drifts away.
translations.lore.nexo.3.title: Echo and Oaths
translations.lore.nexo.3.body: Every bit of care, every battle and every visit from its members feeds the Nexus's Resonance. Its shared voice is the Echo, and its collective goals are the Oaths: fulfilling them tightens the braid and makes it stronger.
translations.lore.nexo.ranks.title: The four ranks of the Nexus
translations.lore.nexo.ranks.lead: If one thread pulls too hard, it frays the others: nobody can act on a thread of their own rank or higher.
translations.lore.nexo.rank.1.title: Nexus Forger
translations.lore.nexo.rank.1.body: The one who tied the first knot. There is only one: they appoint Guardians, can hand the Forge to another thread or undo the Nexus.
translations.lore.nexo.rank.2.title: Guardian
translations.lore.nexo.rank.2.body: Holds the structure together: renames the Nexus, appoints or removes Wardens and expels Wardens and Kin.
translations.lore.nexo.rank.3.title: Warden
translations.lore.nexo.rank.3.body: Watches over the Echo and the door: invites new threads, silences messages, withdraws Oaths and expels Kin.
translations.lore.nexo.rank.4.title: Kin
translations.lore.nexo.rank.4.body: The thread that gives the braid its strength: speaks in the Echo, proposes Oaths and fulfils them.
translations.lore.teaser.lead: From the friction between human life and the ocean of data, the Digital Aether is born — and with it, the pockais. Their origin, their rarities, their elements and their awakening all have a name.
translations.lore.cta.sub: The lore is meant to be lived, not read.
translations.faq.6.q: Is there any cost or monthly subscription?
translations.faq.6.a: No, playing is 100% free. All core content (care, minigames, battles and missions) unlocks by playing without paywalls.
translations.faq.7.q: How are my data and AI conversations protected?
translations.faq.7.a: Your API keys are encrypted with AES at rest. Your conversations are not sold to third parties or used to train models. You have full control to view and delete memories.
translations.faq.8.q: Does it work without an internet connection?
translations.faq.8.a: Yes. You can care for your pockai and play minigames locally. The Arena, missions, and cross-device sync will update as soon as you reconnect.
translations.faq.9.q: What happens to my pet if I change phones?
translations.faq.9.a: Your pockai is linked to your secure account. Logging in or linking your new device with your code restores your pet, level, inventory, and progress intact.
translations.faq.10.q: What are the minimum system requirements?
translations.faq.10.a: On PC it runs on Windows 10 and 11 with minimal background resource usage. On mobile it requires Android 8.0 or higher.
